title: When Beluga Accidentally Hacked The Pentagon... 🚨
description: Beluga clicks a suspicious link promising free cookies, only to accidentally override military satellites and trigger a full FBI tactical raid on his house. #beluga #discord #comedy #fbi #hecker #memes
